messages:
maria: Quick sync — private offer phasing for the HW+SaaS bundle. Need final commit tiers, SI enablement checklist, and joint announce windows. Can we align?

tom: SG. Customer asked for a 12mo commit with ramp. How aggressive do we want to be on discounting?

lee: Recommend graduated discounts to protect unit economics: 20% for initial period with usage floor, then step down to 10% after ramp. Keeps renewal math predictable.

sanjay: We should include an SI onboarding credit tied to first deployments. Suggest $15k service credit per SI for the first 2 closed deals to accelerate config work.

emily: Legal flagged long-tail termination language in the PO template. Can marketing hold public announcement until legal signs off on PO terms?

maria: Proposed plan: private-offer pilot (3 customers) -> marketplace listing. Timeline: pilot start 2024-06-15, listing 2024-07-30. Any objections?

tom: Fine with pilots but marketing needs final co-sell assets 2 weeks before listing. Sales also wants 10 editable co-sell decks we can localize.

lee: For billing simplicity, batch the commit SKUs. Proposed SKU matrix to discuss with billing/marketplace ops: 
```
SKU: HW-BUNDLE-XL
Commit tiers (annualized spend): 50k, 150k, 300k
Discounts: 15%, 20%, 30%
Notes: ramp windows allowed, floor usage 25% monthly
```
Can you confirm marketplace SKU limits?

sanjay: SI onboarding credit: add clause that credits apply across first 2 invoices only, non-refundable, and redeemable only for professional services. I'll draft T&Cs.

emily: Also propose renewals opt-in: unused credits automatically convert to usage discounts at renewal to avoid disputes. Legal prefers explicit consent but will draft fallback language.

maria: Action items:
- tom: deliver co-sell decks by 2024-06-30
- lee: finalize SKU matrix and submit to marketplace ops by 2024-06-25
- sanjay: draft SI credit T&Cs by 2024-06-20
- emily: legal review ETA 2024-06-22
I'll compile pilot list and coordinate coms.

tom: :thumbsup: will do. Any blockers from finance on the committed spend thresholds?

lee: Finance is okay with ramp but wants a monthly floor at 25k/mo as a safeguard. I'll loop finance into the SKU doc.

sanjay: Ping to si-team-bot to create enablement checklist and training slots for partner SIs.

si-team-bot: create_ticket: \"SI Enablement - Private Offer HW Bundle\". Ticket #12345 created. Assignees: lee, sanjay. Due: 2024-06-10.

maria: Great — one more: we need a fallback pricing plan for customers who miss commit targets. Proposed '60-day grace window' then a post-commit adjustment.

tom: Agree. Add a 10% post-commit adjustment after grace, with a mid-term option to convert to a committed tier and apply the corresponding discount retroactively.

emily: Legal asks we avoid the term 'overage fee' in customer-facing copy; use 'post-commit consumption adjustment' in public docs.

maria: Noted. I'll update the pilot brief and share the versioned doc. Thanks team!
